author: Tpk42
body:
Feedback is greatly appreciated! This is my first shot at designing a DTM map.
     Statera is a Nebula DTM map that features two main castles as well as an open battleground. Narrow corridors and small rooms, as well as the map's general smallness, lead to some great fast paced action. Monuments are in a unique spot, with the obsidian being placed high in flags rather than close to the ground. Stronger armor and weapons are somewhat limited in quantity, so make the most of what your team has! 
     Here is everything to run the map: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/rlh5qqfn2hv5zwn/AAD8YzpVDqgENjEXf4OIbN4Ha?dl=0
     More images can be found here *More to join soon*: http://imgur.com/a/FkRnb
Enjoy!
~Tpk42

replies.author: steven5703
replies.body:
Sorry! :(

We're sorry to announce that your map has been denied for testing on the Avicus Network. The reasons are the following:

-As of now, Avicus does not support 1.8 blocks.

-The positioning of the monuments are a little awkward. Try moving the monument to a different place.

-The map is not very aesthetically pleasing and the castle looks plain. Try adding more block variation and adding details in the castle

You may rework your map and update it so we can re-evaluate it. Please use only one forum submission per map, update this thread once you're done. Good luck!

Overall Score:
Gameplay: 6/10
Aesthetics: 4/10
Creativity: 6/10

Thanks for your map submission! :D
